QuestInfo.name: Snail Hunt
QuestInfo.0: Would #p309# in #m10002000# know anything about the Alloy...?
QuestInfo.1: #p309# not only knew about Alloy, but also knew of #o700004#, the snail with the #r#t2210000##k. Wing offered to reveal #o700004#’s location on one condition: bring him some #bsnail shells#k.
QuestInfo.2: Gave snail shells to #p309# and in return got information that #o700004# frequently appeared near the thicket around the beach.

0.0: Hey, it looks like you’re more interested in #r#o700004##k than Alloy. In that case, I can’t give away information that easily. If you really want to know about #r#o700004##k, you’ll have to fulfill my request first.

yes.0: Bring me #b20#k #b#t4000001#s#k, #b20#k #b#t4000002#s#k, and #b20#k #b#t4000004#s#k. That's not too hard, is it? Do this for me, and you'll be on your way to #r#o0700004##k!

no.0: You don't have to if you don't want to. But only fairies know where #r#o0700004##k is. Few humans have even heard of him, so there's no one else you can ask..

1.0: Have you brought all the snail shells? Hmm... Let’s have a look. One, two, three... good! You’ve brought all of them.

yes.0: You want to know what I’m going to do with these? #p407# asked me to get them to master the Three Snails skill. Lucky for me I had you to do the job.

item.0: You haven’t brought all the snail shells yet? I’ll tell you where #r#o0700004##k is after you bring me #b20#k #b#t4000001#s#k, #b20#k #b#t4000002#s#k, and #b20#k #b#t4000004#s#k, 60 shells in total.
